card.title: The Conspiracy Expands
card.instruction: Use every denial, coincidence, and missing detail as proof that more people and higher stakes are involved.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You and your manager both say my train was cancelled. Who told you to match stories?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The signal failed. It's on the public departure board.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: They've recruited the board operators to stop me reaching the interview.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The same fault is delaying three counties.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Three counties to keep me unemployed. My replacement must already have government backing.

mechanism: A interprets broader corroboration of a train fault as evidence of a larger conspiracy targeting A's employment.
confusable: Unlike simple refusal to accept a cancellation, A must increase imagined coordination and stakes with each explanation.
comparison: Three counties imply government backing in A's reasoning, unlike the household receipt becoming commercial warranty distrust.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
